name: Enable Classic Context Menu
description: Enables the classic Windows context menu when right-clicking on files, restoring legacy behavior.

description_i18n.en: Enables the classic Windows context menu when right-clicking on files, restoring legacy behavior.
description_i18n.de: Aktiviert das klassische Windows-Kontextmenü beim Rechtsklick auf Dateien und stellt die veraltete Verhalten wieder her.
description_i18n.fr: Active le menu contextuel classique de Windows lors du clic droit sur des fichiers et restaure le comportement hérité.

warnings.title: Registry Modification
warnings.message: Modifies user-specific Explorer settings in the registry. Reverts on profile reset or new user creation.

compatibility.notes: Designed for supported Windows desktop systems.

technical_details: This tweak modifies the current user's registry to restore the classic Windows context menu by creating the {86ca1aa0-34aa-4e8b-a509-50c905bae2a2}\InprocServer32 CLSID override under HKEY_CURRENT_USER\Software\Classes\CLSID.
